title_sq: Tek Shkolla E Bashkuar, Shitet Apartament 2+1+Post Parkimi, Me Pamje Te Lire Dhe Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Tek Shkolla E Bashkuar, Shitet Apartament 2+1+Post Parkimi, Me Pamje Te Lire Dhe Planimetri Te Rregullt!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje pallati me 5 kate dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto 95.5 m2 nga te cilat 88.1 m2 neto. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes se bashku me kendin e kuzhines, 2 dhoma gjumi, tualeti dhe ballkoni. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje pallat te mireadministruar dhe i pajisur me ashensor. Prona eshte e investuar me sistem termoizolimi, e pajisur me kondicioner dhe e mobiluar ne menyre komode. Ne cmim eshte i perfshire dhe nje post parkimi. Orientimi eshte Jug-Perendim dhe mundeson ndricim natyral ne pjesen me te madhe te dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nder zonat me te kerkuara dhe me te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Near the United School, 2+1+Parking Post Apartment for sale, with a clear view and a regular floor plan!!!
description_en: Near the United School, 2+1+Parking Post Apartment for sale, with a clear view and a regular floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a 5-story building and has a gross area of ​​95.5 m2, of which 88.1 m2 is net. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room together with kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, toilet and balcony. The apartment is located in a well-managed building equipped with an elevator. The property is invested with a thermal insulation system, equipped with air conditioning and comfortably furnished. A parking post is included in the price. The orientation is South-West and enables natural lighting during most of the day. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas with all the facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life. The property has full mortgage documentation.
